items.description:
The IPO was priced on Oct. 6, before the latest sell-off in AI-related stocks, analysts told CNBC. "Elice's debut shows the AI infrastructure trade has moved from 'build at any cost' to 'who is paying and for how long'," said Ke Yan of Shenton Research.

Other AI infrastructure companies have also struggled. CoreWeave's shares have lost more than half their value since their May peak....
items.bullet_summary_preload:
- **Elice** closed well below its 90,500-won offer price in Tuesday's **Kosdaq** debut, the worst first day for a sizeable South Korean IPO, according to Bloomberg data[1].
- The listing raised 201 billion won, the largest Kosdaq IPO this year, and both its institutional and retail tranches were oversubscribed hundreds of times[1][5].
- The slump added to doubts about AI spending, and the **Kospi** closed lower as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell, Business Insider reported[2].

items.description:
Israel's October 27 vote will be its first national election since the Hamas attack of October 7, 2023, which led to wars in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran, according to Reuters. Polls suggest neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition will reach the 61 seats needed to form a coalition, DW reported. The opposition bloc is led by former army chief Gadi Eisenkot, Middle East Eye reported.

Also on...
items.bullet_summary_preload:
- Vice President **JD Vance** declined Monday to endorse **Benjamin Netanyahu**, saying, "I'm not anti-endorsing him, but I'm not pro-endorsing him," according to Politico[1].
- President **Donald Trump** gave Netanyahu his "Complete and Total Endorsement" on Truth Social on Sunday and tied it to the war with **Iran**, Axios reported[5].
- Polls show neither bloc reaching 61 seats before the Oct. 27 vote, and Defense Secretary **Pete Hegseth** met Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel[4][2].
